turns.instruction:
Build the attached three-dimensional frame using PKPM. Story 1 floor pressure is 8 kN/m2; story 2 pressure is unspecified. Resolve that missing magnitude, then report the specified responses. Retain the distinct BX and BY sections; the geometry determines all tributary widths.
Use the stated PKPM engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Story 2 pressure is 8 kN/m2 downward. Apply it only to the story 2 X beams using the stated tributary-width rule, then analyze and report all requested responses. Keep the first-story load and BX/BY properties.
